title: Swift Combat
description: A performance friendly modpack to help you in combat! Made for Forge!
body:
**This simple modpack for Forge adds small but essential additions to make combat just work**

**Features:**
- 5 shaders from lightweight and performance friendly to powerful and outstanding are included!
- Forge loader so it includes a vast number of unique mods that help you in combat
- Multiple performance mods giving you speed without clutter
- Dynamic crosshair and additions to HUD for an easier way to aim and check FPS, ping, tool durability, etc
- Small changes like lower fire, lower shields, crosshair style are included to get rid of annoyances

This modpack was made by the youtuber Vision - 
[YouTube Link](https://www.youtube.com/@Vision_Minecraft/featured)
